name: ePayServices Open API
description: ePayServices Open API providing Account Information Services (AIS) and Payment Initiation Services (PIS) for payment providers and third-party developers. Supports OAuth2 and OpenID Connect for secure authentication. Enables access to account history, transaction data, internal transfers, and payment initiation with customer-authorized data access.
